description:
FILED s512 (Fable, 2026-10-08) from perf round 41's checkpoint report (s512p, worktree agent-ad4d28a21ff7f772a, scratch/s512p/STOP.md): with the #2723 wrapper loaded, the 30 000-iteration reproducer (`my %h; for my $i (1..30000) { $h{u} .= "line $i\n"; $m++ if $h{u} =~ /9\n\z/ }`) drops from 14.0 s to 2.6 s, and the SAME loop WITHOUT the match takes 2.67 s on main (perl 0.01 s) -- so the remaining cost is the append, not the regex.  CONTRADICTS the s509 table (DECIDED `## s509`, docs/faster-codegen-suggestions.md round 39: 30 000 appends to a hash element 1.58 s -> 0.05 s behind the `:strbuf` cell) unless the shape differs.

THE CHEAP DISCRIMINATING MEASUREMENT (3 minutes, do it before anything else): on a QUIET box (load < 2), time four spellings x 30 000 on main vs perl: (a) `$h{u} .= "line $i\n"` (the report's); (b) `$h{u} .= $s` with a precomputed string; (c) `my $u; $u .= "line $i\n"` (a lexical); (d) the s509 table's exact program (`~/pcl-agent-scratch/s509/review/sb/sb.pl` or its appmatch2.pl section `append`).  If (d) is 0.05 s and (a) is 2.6 s the in-place path is missed by the INTERPOLATED right side (p-string-concat feeding `.=`); if (b) is also slow it is the hash element; if all are ~0.05 s the 2.67 s was load.  Then file the real task or close this one with the numbers.  Perf round 41 (s512p) resumes with this as the first thing it measures when it continues #2723 (its reproducer's remaining time is this).
=== DONE (s512p, 2026-10-08 23:41) === MEASURED on a quiet box (heavy.sh bench, load 0.9-1.3; best of 3, warm, wall incl. ~0.175 s start-up; log $W/scratch/s512p/m2875/bench.log, W=agent-ad4d28a21ff7f772a, tree = main 5adcc156 + the #2723 WIP, base = extraction of 5adcc156):
  (a) my %h; $h{u} .= "line $i\n" x30000      perl 0.003  base 0.190  tree 0.186   (empty program 0.175 -> the append is ~0.015 s)
  (b) $h{u} .= $s (precomputed)               perl 0.002  base 0.184  tree 0.184
  (c) my $u; $u .= "line $i\n" (FILE lexical) perl 0.002  base 2.062  tree 2.070
  (d) the s509 sb.pl table: not measurable through runpcl (runpcl passes no @ARGV); (a) is its shape.
VERDICT: the s509 :strbuf number HOLDS for the hash element (no regression, the report's 2.6 s for the hash spelling was the hand-replaced harness's source load).  The REAL residue is spelling (c): a lexical declared WITHOUT an initializer (`my $u;`) emits `(p-let (($u :scalar (p-undef))) ... (p-.=-raw $u ...))` -- quadratic, 2.06 s -- while `my $u = "";` takes the :str-buffer slot (0.23 s incl. start-up); the same in a sub (2.53 s).  Filed as #2880.  Closed.
